video.title: AI欧腐《我的宿敌变成了猫/My Archenemy Became a Cat》
video.desc:
很好 变成了缅因 变猫还能选品种吗
Wealthy young master Julian is framed by his step‑mother and step‑brother, cursed by a witch into a Maine Coon cat. Wandering the streets, he is rescued by his arch‑rival Elias. Staying with Elias, Julian accidentally discovers the man’s long‑hidden crush on him. After misunderstandings and manhunts, the curse is lifted. Julian exposes his step‑mother’s plot to seize his fortune at his own funeral. Overcoming family obstacles, the two resolve their old grudges and finally find happiness together.
富家少爷 Julian 遭继母与继兄联手构陷，被女巫诅咒变成了一只缅因猫。流落街头的他，被自己的死对头 Elias 所救。寄住在 Elias 家中的日子里，Julian 意外发现了对方隐藏已久的暗恋心事。经历重重误会与追捕之后，诅咒终被解除。Julian 在自己的"葬礼"上当众揭穿继母企图侵吞家产的阴谋。两人在跨过重重家族阻碍后，终于放下旧日恩怨，携手迎来了属于彼此的幸福。
